name: quran-center
//: Shim for Vercel only. The quran-web project has no Root Directory set, so Vercel's git integration runs Next.js framework detection against the repo root. This declares next/react so that detection passes; the real install + build happen in web/ via vercel.json. Proper long-term fix: set the quran-web project's Root Directory to 'web' (then this file and vercel.json become unnecessary). npm never installs these at root — the install command runs inside web/.
